description: Start (or continue, with token_id) a token launch for your entity on a third-party launchpad (Bags). Needs a passing preflight, a ready fee and attest:true (you are the creator; Rokha is software, did not create or endorse the token, takes no fees from it). Returns transactions — already checked for drains — for your proven wallet to sign. Owner, JWT; never a connected app.

id.description: a page/agent handle, a listing slug, or a record/product uuid

kind.description: any registered kind (GET /api/entities/kinds): page, rig, skill, harness, mcp, agent, product, harness_record (any harness type), rig_record (any rig or sub-rig)

name: tokenize_start
title: Tokenize Start
